item.title: Lucid's third-quarter deliveries miss estimates as it cuts output to run down inventory
item.description: Lucid Group's third-quarter deliveries fell short of Wall Street estimates on Monday, with the luxury EV maker reducing production from the prior quarter and selling vehicles from its existing inventory as part of a cost-cutting overhaul.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Lucid Group's (LCID.O) third-quarter deliveries fell short of Wall Street estimates on Monday, with the luxury EV maker reducing production from the prior quarter and selling vehicles from its existing inventory as part of a cost-cutting overhaul. Here are some details: Lucid delivered 3,806 vehicles in the quarter ended September 30, below the average analyst estimate of 4,687, according to Visible Alpha data. It built 2,954 vehicles, compared with the 3,709 analysts had expected. Output fell 38% to 2,954 units from 4,774 vehicles in the second quarter after it eliminated a second shift at its AMP-1 plant in Arizona. Deliveries exceeded production by 852 vehicles as Lucid turned unsold cars into sales. This is part of a cost-saving initiative that targets $1.4 billion in cash flow improvements this year. The company said demand for its Gravity SUV "continued to regain momentum," but gave no figures. Lucid has delivered 10,852 vehicles so far this year. To meet analysts' full-year estimate of about 17,070, it would need to deliver roughly 6,200 in the fourth quarter, higher than its quarterly record of 5,345, set in the fourth quarter of 2025.

item.title: Trump says US will help Russia after Siberia plague institute death
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Monday at the White House told reporters that the United States will help Russia after a laboratory worker died at a plague research institute in Siberia.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Monday at the White House told reporters that the United States will help Russia after a laboratory worker died at a plague research institute in Siberia. Trump told reporters as he left the White House for a trip to Nebraska that the outbreak is a "big problem for Russia." A laboratory worker at a plague research institute in Siberia fell ill and died in undisclosed circumstances, prompting authorities to quarantine dozens of people. The death has sparked public health fears on social media, but Russian authorities said on Monday the situation was under control. "Well, I hate to see them having it," Trump said. "It's a rough disease." He said the US would do what it could to help Russia. Trump has said he considers Russian President Vladimir Putin someone whom he can work with despite tensions over Russia's war against Ukraine. "We'll help," Trump said. "Anybody that has that kind of a problem, we're always will to help."

item.title: 原油先物約2ドル安、中東の輸出増とＧ７備蓄放出で
item.description:
Nicole Jao
[ニューヨーク ５日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は約２ドル下落した。中東からの原油輸出が増加したほか、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）が石油備蓄の協調放出を約束したことが背景。ただ、米国とイランの戦争に伴う供給混乱への懸念が根強く、下値は限られた。
清算値は、北海ブレント先物が１．９３ドル（１．８９％）安の１バレル＝１００．３２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．６８ドル（１．８４％）安の８９．４３ドルだった。
Ｇ７は２日、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、ディーゼル燃料（軽油）などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。
また、
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nicole Jao

[ニューヨーク ５日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は約２ドル下落した。中東からの原油輸出が増加したほか、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）が石油備蓄の協調放出を約束したことが背景。ただ、米国とイランの戦争に伴う供給混乱への懸念が根強く、下値は限られた。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が１．９３ドル（１．８９％）安の１バレル＝１００．３２ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は１．６８ドル（１．８４％）安の８９．４３ドルだった。

Ｇ７は２日、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、ディーゼル燃料（軽油）などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。

また、 湾岸地域の産油国による原油輸出量が９月のほぼ半分の期間で戦争前の水準を上回ったことが、５日の海運データから明らかになった。

ただ、ＰＶＭオイル・アソシエーツのアナリスト、タマシュ・バルガ氏は「中東での停戦は依然として見通せない。サウジアラビアとイランが支援するフーシ派の戦闘再燃により、エネルギー施設や船舶への攻撃は続き、地政学的リスクプレミアムは高水準にとどまるだろう」との見方を示した。

ロンドンで開催された「エネルギー・インテリジェンス」会議に出席した石油業界の幹部らも、海上輸送の停滞や製油所の大幅減産、在庫の取り崩しにより、世界の原油価格は２０２７年以降も高止まりするとの見通しを示した。

item.title: Aprovação de Trump atinge nível recorde de baixa; hispânicos estão descontentes com os republicanos, diz Reuters/Ipsos
item.description: O índice de aprovação do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, permanece em um nível recorde de baixa nos últimos dias, enquanto muitos eleitores hispânicos criticam seu desempenho no cargo e planejam rejeitar o Partido Republicano nas eleições de meio de mandato previstas para o próximo mês, mostrou pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos divulgada nesta segunda-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O índice de aprovação do presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, permanece em um nível recorde de baixa nos últimos dias, enquanto muitos eleitores hispânicos criticam seu desempenho no cargo e planejam rejeitar o Partido Republicano nas eleições de meio de mandato previstas para o próximo mês, mostrou pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos divulgada nesta segunda-feira. Realizada ao longo de seis dias, a pesquisa mostrou que 32% dos norte-americanos aprovam a presidência de Trump, número inalterado em relação à rodada de setembro, que registrou o índice de aprovação do líder no nível mais baixo de sua carreira política. Os eleitores hispânicos ajudaram a impulsionar Trump à vitória na disputa presidencial de 2024, quando ele conquistou quase metade dos votos nesta fatia do eleitorado, em comparação com cerca de um terço na eleição de 2020. Mas o apoio ao presidente diminuiu nos últimos meses, à medida que os norte-americanos enfrentam a alta inflação provocada pela decisão de Trump de entrar em guerra com o Irã. Apenas 24% dos hispano-americanos aprovam o desempenho de Trump na Casa Branca, a menor porcentagem em qualquer um dos dois mandatos presidenciais de Trump. E, em um sinal de que a baixa popularidade de Trump está pesando fortemente sobre o Partido Republicano, apenas 26% dos eleitores hispânicos registrados planejam votar nos republicanos nas eleições de 3 de novembro, que determinarão o controle das duas Casas do Congresso durante os dois últimos anos do atual mandato de Trump. Cerca de 52% dos eleitores hispânicos pretendem votar nos democratas, o que representa aproximadamente o dobro do nível de apoio aos republicanos e a maior vantagem democrata desde que Trump assumiu o cargo. Realizada online e em todo o país, a pesquisa da Reuters/Ipsos entrevistou 4.506 adultos norte-americanos e tem margem de erro de cerca de dois pontos percentuais.

item.title: Mariners' Cal Raleigh, Josh Naylor undergo procedures
item.description: Seattle Mariners catcher Cal Raleigh and infielder Josh Naylor underwent surgery Saturday and are expected to be fully recovered before spring training, the team announced Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Seattle Mariners catcher Cal Raleigh and infielder Josh Naylor underwent surgery Saturday and are expected to be fully recovered before spring training, the team announced Monday. Raleigh, 29, had a debridement procedure on his left shoulder, while the 29-year-old Naylor underwent surgery on his right wrist. Following a historic 2025 season in which he hit a major league-leading 60 home runs, finished second in American League MVP voting and earned his first All-Star nod, Raleigh's production declined in 2026. In 126 games, he batted just .182 with 23 home runs and 69 RBIs. A right oblique strain sidelined him for a month in his first stint on the injured list. In parts of six seasons, all with the Mariners, Raleigh is a .218 hitter with 176 homers and 445 RBIs in 749 games. Naylor hit .261 with 10 home runs, 30 stolen bases and 57 RBIs in 152 games in 2026, his first full season with the Mariners. A first-round pick (No. 12 overall) of the Miami Marlins in 2015, Naylor is a .268 hitter with 114 home runs, 85 stolen bases and 492 RBIs in 897 games with the San Diego Padres (2019-20), Cleveland Guardians (2020-24), Arizona Diamondbacks (2025) and Mariners (2025-present). Naylor was an All-Star in 2024, when he set career highs with 31 home runs and 108 RBIs while batting .243. --Field Level Media

item.title: Buccaneers say S Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib) out 2-4 weeks
item.description: Tampa Bay Buccaneers safety Antoine Winfield Jr. will miss two to four weeks after suffering a rib fracture, coach Todd Bowles said Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Tampa Bay Buccaneers safety Antoine Winfield Jr. will miss two to four weeks after suffering a rib fracture, coach Todd Bowles said Monday. Winfield, 28, suffered the injury late in Tampa Bay's 17-14 loss to the Green Bay Packers on Sunday that dropped the Bucs to 0-4. A two-time Pro Bowler (2021, 2025) and former first-team All-Pro (2023), Winfield has nine career interceptions, 13 forced fumbles, 18 sacks and 561 tackles in 89 career games (all starts). This is his seventh NFL season after being selected by Tampa Bay in the second round of the 2020 draft. Winfield had 24 tackles through the first four games of this season. The Buccaneers, already playing without starting quarterback Baker Mayfield, have a short week as they prepare to visit the Dallas Cowboys on Thursday. --Field Level Media

item.title: Popularidad de Trump cae a mínimo, latinos se muestran descontentos con republicanos: sondeo Reuters/Ipsos
item.description: El índice de aprobación de Donald Trump se mantuvo en mínimos históricos, ya que muchos votantes latinos han criticado duramente su gestión y tienen previsto dar la espalda al Partido Republicano en las elecciones legislativas del próximo mes, según una encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos finalizada el lunes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El índice de aprobación de Donald Trump se mantuvo en mínimos históricos, ya que muchos votantes latinos han criticado duramente su gestión y tienen previsto dar la espalda al Partido Republicano en las elecciones legislativas del próximo mes, según una encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos finalizada el lunes. La encuesta, de seis días, reveló que el 32% de los estadounidenses valoraba positivamente la presidencia de Trump, un dato que no ha variado respecto de un sondeo de Reuters/Ipsos de septiembre, en la que la valoración del líder se situó en el nivel más bajo de su carrera política. Los votantes latinos contribuyeron a impulsar a Trump hacia la victoria en las elecciones de 2024, cuando obtuvo casi la mitad de su voto, frente a aproximadamente un tercio en 2020. Sin embargo, el apoyo al presidente ha caído en los últimos meses, porque los estadounidenses se enfrentan a una alta inflación por la decisión de entrar en guerra con Irán. Solo el 24% de los latinos aprueba la actuación de Trump en la Casa Blanca, el porcentaje más bajo en cualquiera de sus dos mandatos. Y, en una señal de que la baja popularidad de Trump está pesando mucho sobre su partido, solo el 26% de los votantes latinos tiene previsto votar a los republicanos en las elecciones del 3 de noviembre, que determinarán el control de ambas cámaras del Congreso durante los dos últimos años del actual mandato del presidente. Alrededor del 52% de los votantes hispanos tiene previsto votar a los demócratas, lo que supone aproximadamente el doble del nivel de apoyo a los republicanos y la mayor ventaja demócrata desde que Trump asumió el cargo. La encuesta de Reuters/Ipsos, realizada en línea y a escala nacional, se llevó a cabo entre 4.506 adultos estadounidenses y tuvo un margen de error de aproximadamente dos puntos porcentuales.

item.title: Report: Chargers OT Rashawn Slater to miss time with ankle injury
item.description: Los Angeles Chargers left tackle Rashawn Slater is believed to have a high ankle sprain and is expected to miss multiple weeks, ESPN reported Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los Angeles Chargers left tackle Rashawn Slater is believed to have a high ankle sprain and is expected to miss multiple weeks, ESPN reported Monday. Slater's injury is yet another blow for the Chargers' offensive line, which saw right tackle Joe Alt leave Sunday's 30-23 loss against the Seattle Seahawks with a neck injury while left guard Trevor Penning was being checked for a concussion. Those issues have come after new center Tyler Biadasz was lost for the season with a knee injury during training camp. The Chargers are off to an 0-4 start as quarterback Justin Herbert has completed 59.7% of his passes, which is 24th in the NFL. He has four touchdown passes to six interceptions and has been sacked 12 times, which is one off the NFL lead. Slater, 27, was named to the Pro Bowl in 2021 and 2024. He missed the 2025 campaign after tearing a patellar tendon during camp. He started each of the Chargers' first four games and has started in all 55 games he has played since he was a first-round draft pick by the Chargers out of Northwestern in 2021. --Field Level Media

item.title: Islamic State attack kills Iraqi policeman near Kirkuk
item.description: At least one Iraqi federal policeman was killed and four others wounded on Monday when Islamic State militants attacked a federal police site southwest of the oil-rich city of Kirkuk, two security sources told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: At least one Iraqi federal policeman was killed and four others wounded on Monday when Islamic State militants attacked a federal police site southwest of the oil-rich city of Kirkuk, two security sources told Reuters. The attackers used semi-automatic machine guns and sniper fire against the federal police regiment stationed near Hawija, about 70 km (43 miles) southwest of Kirkuk, the sources said. There was no immediate claim of responsibility. But security and army sources said Islamic State militants, who are still active in the area, were involved in the attack. The attack is the first reported assault by Islamic State militants on Iraqi security forces since US forces completed their [USN:L6N45L0KD TEXT:"withdrawal"] from Iraq on September 30, ending the military mission in the country. The United States had led a coalition that supported Iraqi forces in the fight against Islamic State, including efforts to prevent the militant group from regrouping. Washington said it would continue to provide targeted training and intelligence support after the withdrawal, while Iraqi forces would take full responsibility for the country’s security and for suppressing Islamic State remnants. Despite the defeat of Islamic State’s self-declared caliphate nearly a decade ago, the group retains [USN:L8N45K0OM TEXT:"sleeper cells"] in Iraq, Iraqi security officials told Reuters ahead of the US withdrawal. The withdrawal had raised concerns that a security vacuum could provide an opening for Islamic State to regain strength, with some officials warning that Iraqi forces would now have to contain the group without the coalition’s military presence.

item.title: Vídeo foi adulterado para simular que Flávio criticou direitos trabalhistas
item.description: Um vídeo no qual o candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) aparece criticando direitos trabalhistas foi adulterado. No registro original, o senador falava sobre antissemitismo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo no qual o candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) aparece criticando direitos trabalhistas foi adulterado. No registro original, o senador falava sobre antissemitismo. Estes são os principais detalhes: “Flávio Bolsonaro já deixou claro que vai cortar direitos trabalhistas”, descreve a legenda de publicações no Facebook, no Instagram e no Threads com a gravação. Nas imagens manipuladas, o candidato afirma: “Como meu pai dizia e agora eu vou falar, todos nós sabemos que o salário é pouco para quem recebe e muito para quem paga. O trabalhador vai ter que decidir um dia entre ter menos direitos e emprego ou todos os direitos e desemprego”. Flávio compartilhou o vídeo original em seu perfil no TikTok em janeiro deste ano, no qual fala sobre sua visita a Israel e ao Memorial do Holocausto. Na filmagem , Flávio aparece à frente do irmão, o ex-deputado federal Eduardo Bolsonaro. Ao fundo, há um painel onde se lê, em inglês, “2ª Conferência Internacional de Combate ao Antissemitismo”. Os dois participaram do evento , que ocorreu no início do ano em Israel. Veredicto: Alterado digitalmente. Um vídeo de Flávio Bolsonaro falando sobre antissemitismo foi manipulado para simular que ele fez críticas a direitos trabalhistas. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: Genmab, AbbVie blood cancer drug combo cuts risk of progression or death in late-stage study
item.description: Danish biotech firm Genmab and US drugmaker AbbVie said on Monday their combination treatment for patients newly diagnosed with a type of lymphoma reduced the risk of disease progression or death in a late-stage study.
item.dc:creator: Sahil Pandey
item.content:encoded: Danish biotech firm Genmab (GMAB.CO) and US drugmaker AbbVie (ABBV.N) said on Monday their combination treatment for patients newly diagnosed with a type of lymphoma reduced the risk of disease progression or death in a late-stage study. US-listed shares of Genmab were up about 1.04% in extended trading. AbbVie's shares were flat. The study tested epcoritamab in combination with R-CHOP in newly diagnosed patients with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL), the most common type of non-Hodgkin lymphoma The combination reduced the risk of disease progression or death by 51% in newly diagnosed patients compared with R-CHOP alone, the companies said Barclays analyst Emily Field said the result was a strong validation of epcoritamab in frontline DLBCL, which represents the largest commercial opportunity for the drug Epcoritamab, jointly developed by Genmab and AbbVie, is an immune-based therapy that helps the body's T cells attack cancer cells, while R-CHOP is currently offered as the standard treatment for those with DLBCL The companies said the trial is the first late-stage study of a bispecific antibody combination to significantly improve progression-free survival — how long patients live without their cancer worsening — in first-line DLBCL They said the combination's safety profile was generally consistent with the known safety profiles of epcoritamab and R-CHOP Epcoritamab has not yet been approved for patients who have just been diagnosed and have not received prior treatment

item.title: SpaceX seeks approval for Florida gas pipeline to support Cape Canaveral launches
item.description: Elon Musk's SpaceX is seeking approval to build a natural gas pipeline in Florida to supply fuel for its rocket launched from Cape Canaveral, according to a state regulatory filing from September.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Elon Musk's SpaceX (SPCX.O) is seeking approval to build a natural gas pipeline in Florida to supply fuel for its rocket launched from Cape Canaveral, according to a state regulatory filing from September. A SpaceX subsidiary, Coastal Connect Services (CCS), has requested the Florida Public Service Commission to approve a tariff for a new 32.4-mile, 16-inch natural gas transmission pipeline in Brevard County, where Cape Canaveral is located. Here are some details: This infrastructure is expected to provide supply of natural gas, as SpaceX uses methane in liquid form as propellant in its Starship rockets. SpaceX did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. CCS has proposed to build and operate pipeline facilities that would bring natural gas from the existing Florida Gas Transmission (FGT) interstate pipeline directly to its customers, according to the filing. In the petition, the company said the pipeline is crucial for safe, timely and efficient natural gas delivery, as current truck-based supply and existing local pipelines cannot meet SpaceX's growing needs at Cape Canaveral. The proposed pipeline would be similar [USN:L1N42U103 TEXT:"to an 8-mile pipeline SpaceX"] has also requested for its Boca Chica launch site in South Texas. SpaceX has started hiring natural gas traders as it seeks to secure a reliable, cost-effective fuel supply for Starship launches from Florida and Texas, according to Bloomberg News, which first reported the development. SpaceX's move into gas infrastructure, typically the domain of energy and pipeline firms, underscores its longstanding strategy of controlling as much of its supply chain as possible, a capital‑intensive approach that has helped the company outpace rivals in rocket and spacecraft development.

item.title: Canadian dollar hits 18-month low as France worries boost greenback
item.description: The Canadian dollar weakened to an 18-month low against its US counterpart on Monday as the greenback posted broad-based gains and after domestic data showed the services sector contracting for a fourth straight month.
item.dc:creator: Fergal Smith
item.content:encoded: The Canadian dollar weakened to an 18-month low against its US counterpart on Monday as the greenback posted broad-based gains and after domestic data showed the services sector contracting for a fourth straight month. The loonie was trading 0.1% lower at 1.4257 per US dollar, or 70.14 US cents, after touching its weakest intraday level since April 2025 at 1.4293. "The moves in CAD were largely dictated by developments in Europe as opposed to domestic developments here in Canada," said George Davis, chief technical strategist at RBC Capital Markets. "The resulting USD strength weighed on CAD in this regard." The US dollar rose against a basket of major currencies as concerns about France's ability to rein in its budget deficit weighed on the [USN:L6N45R0RD TEXT:"euro"] . [USN:L6N45L0U9 TEXT:"Canada's services economy"] contracted in September as tariffs and the war in the Middle East contributed to economic uncertainty, S&P Global's Canada services PMI data showed. The headline Business Activity Index rose to 48.3 last month from 46.8 in August but remained below the 50 no-change mark. The price of oil, one of Canada's major exports, fell after crude exports from the Middle East increased and the Group of Seven nations pledged to boost supplies. US crude oil futures settled 1.8% lower at $89.43 a barrel. Speculators have raised their bearish bets on the Canadian dollar, data from the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission showed on Friday. Non-commercial net short positions rose to 78,671 contracts as of September 29, up from 53,210 in the prior week. Canadian bond yields moved higher across a steeper curve. The 10-year was up 4.4 basis points at 3.989%, moving closer to the nearly three-year high it touched last Thursday at 4.042%. The predominantly French-speaking Canadian province of [USN:L1N4590X4 TEXT:"Quebec"] was headed to the polls on Monday and while a separatist party looks set to win, the campaign's focus has been more on US President Donald Trump than on independence.

item.title: Aramco alerta que el colchón mundial de petróleo es “preocupantemente” bajo por la crisis de Ormuz
item.description: Las reservas mundiales de petróleo se han reducido de unos 10.000 millones a menos de 6.000 millones de barriles desde el inicio de la guerra entre EE.UU. e Irán, según el CEO de Saudi Aramco.
item.dc:creator: Anthony Di Paola, Grant Smith, Charles Gorrivan
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Las reservas de petróleo que protegen al mundo de las crisis de suministro se han reducido hasta alcanzar niveles “preocupantemente bajos”, lo que pone a los mercados en riesgo de que la situación empeore a menos que se reabra el estrecho de Ormuz, según el director de la empresa estatal productora de Arabia Saudita. El director de la mayor empresa exportadora de crudo del mundo hizo estas declaraciones apenas unos días después de que los gobiernos de las principales economías mundiales anunciaran planes para liberar hasta 100 millones de barriles de reservas de emergencia de petróleo y gasóleo con el fin de aliviar el aumento de los costes del combustible. “Hasta que el estrecho de Ormuz se reabra por completo y se recupere la confianza, la cruda realidad es que la presión en ambos extremos del barril se intensificará”, afirmó Amin Nasser, CEO de Saudi Aramco, el lunes en el Energy Intelligence Forum celebrado en Londres. “Si bien la escasez de crudo es grave, los precios de los combustibles refinados han subido aún más bruscamente”. Ver más: Petróleo cae hacia los US$100 tras fuerte recorte de Arabia Saudita al precio de su crudo para Asia El consumo de crudo sigue aumentando y los países necesitarán aún más suministro durante al menos los próximos dos años, mientras reponen sus reservas, señaló Nasser. Esto podría suponer una demanda adicional de al menos 2 millones de barriles al día, o incluso más si los gobiernos deciden aumentar la cantidad de petróleo que mantienen en sus reservas, añadió. Cuando comenzó la guerra entre Estados Unidos e Irán, el mundo contaba con unas reservas de petróleo de unos 10.000 millones de barriles, señaló Nasser. Esa cifra se ha reducido a menos de 6.000 millones, de los cuales aproximadamente el 10% está realmente disponible debido a diversas restricciones técnicas, añadió. Liberar parte de lo que queda en las reservas mundiales dará un respiro a las economías, pero no solucionará los desequilibrios entre la oferta y la demanda, señaló Nasser. Los productores del Golfo están trabajando para aumentar la producción y las exportaciones, y han logrado elevar los flujos de crudo hasta niveles cercanos a los previos a la guerra. Ver más: OPEP+ acuerda mantener sin cambios los objetivos de producción de petróleo en noviembre Arabia Saudita y países vecinos como los Emiratos Árabes Unidos y Kuwait han estado utilizando sus propios petroleros para transportar crudo a través del estrecho de Ormuz, que ha estado obstruido, al menos en parte, desde que Estados Unidos e Israel atacaron Irán a finales de febrero, lo que desencadenó una guerra regional. El aumento de los flujos ha supuesto un escaso alivio para los mercados petroleros, que siguen descontando en sus precios los riesgos de seguridad que afectan al suministro en el Golfo Pérsico y el Mar Rojo. El crudo Brent, el referente internacional, se ha cotizado en torno a los US$100 por barril durante el último mes, a pesar de que un mayor número de petroleros ha transitado por el estrecho de Ormuz. Esos buques han tenido que asumir el riesgo de sufrir un aumento de los ataques, mientras que Arabia Saudita ha sido blanco de ataques en repetidas ocasiones durante el último mes. Ver más: G7 liberará hasta 100 millones de barriles de petróleo y diésel ante el alza de precios No obstante, toda la capacidad de producción de Aramco permanece intacta, afirmó Nasser. Esto ha permitido a la empresa seguir cumpliendo sus contratos de suministro con compradores de Europa y Asia. La empresa ha utilizado diversas rutas de exportación, ha reasignado el suministro entre sus diferentes calidades de crudo y ha puesto en servicio sus propios petroleros para abastecer a los clientes, señaló. Durante el último mes, Aramco ha incrementado los envíos de crudo desde su principal terminal de exportación en Ras Tanura, en el Golfo Pérsico. La empresa reaccionó con rapidez ante la interrupción temporal de su principal oleoducto transnacional tras un ataque el mes pasado y, desde entonces, ha restablecido los flujos hasta alcanzar aproximadamente el 80% de su capacidad. Aramco está buscando rutas alternativas de exportación de crudo para evitar depender en exceso de un único método para llegar a los compradores globales, afirmó Nasser, sin dar más detalles. La empresa está estudiando planes que duplicarían o triplicarían la capacidad de sus instalaciones de almacenamiento, añadió. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Precios de la soja suben a medida que el real brasileño se dispara tras las elecciones
item.description: El real brasileño se apreció hasta 5% tras la primera vuelta presidencial, lo que podría reducir la agresividad de los agricultores brasileños para vender soja y favorecer la competitividad de las exp ...
item.dc:creator: Dayanne Sousa
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los futuros de la soja subieron el lunes en Chicago después de que un resultado inesperado en la primera vuelta de las elecciones presidenciales de Brasil provocara una fuerte subida del real brasileño, lo que encareció las exportaciones de este cultivo. El real se apreció hasta un 5% frente al dólar estadounidense después de que Flávio Bolsonaro, favorito de los inversores, saliera de la primera vuelta electoral como favorito para hacerse con la presidencia en la segunda vuelta que se celebrará a finales de este mes. Brasil es el principal proveedor mundial de soja. El contrato de soja más negociado en Chicago subió hasta un 1,5% antes de recortar sus ganancias. Ver más: ¿Qué está en juego para la economía de Brasil y su relación con Trump en la segunda vuelta? “La subida del real suele significar que los agricultores brasileños se mostrarán menos agresivos a la hora de vender, y que las exportaciones estadounidenses serán más competitivas”, señalaron los analistas de Hightower Report en una nota publicada el lunes. Brasil ya ha vendido gran parte de sus existencias de la cosecha anterior, lo que suele reducir la competencia con la soja estadounidense en esta época del año. Los operadores también están atentos al ritmo de la siembra de soja en Brasil; las últimas cifras de la consultora AgRural muestran que, por primera vez esta temporada, las tasas son inferiores a las del año anterior. Se ha completado aproximadamente el 7,3% de la siembra, frente al 9% de hace un año, debido a las lluvias excesivas en el sur del país. En otros mercados de cereales, los futuros del trigo de Chicago subieron hasta un 2,3%, registrando su tercer día consecutivo de subidas después de que Rusia amenazara con intensificar los ataques contra las infraestructuras de Ucrania, lo que ha avivado los temores sobre una escalada del conflicto. -Con la colaboración de Ben Westcott, Pyotr Kozlov y Muneeza Naqvi. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Trump approval at record low; Hispanic voters sour on Republicans, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
item.description: President Donald Trump's approval rating held at a record low in recent days, as many Hispanic voters panned his job performance and planned to spurn his Republican Party in next month's midterm elections, according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll completed on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump's approval rating held at a record low in recent days, as many Hispanic voters panned his job performance and planned to spurn his Republican Party in next month's midterm elections , according to a Reuters/Ipsos poll completed on Monday. The six-day poll showed 32% of Americans giving a thumbs up to Trump's presidency, unchanged from a September Reuters/Ipsos survey that saw the leader's rating at the lowest of his political career. Hispanic voters helped propel Trump to victory in the 2024 presidential contest, when he won nearly half the Hispanic vote compared with roughly one-third in the 2020 election. But support for the president has waned in recent months as Americans struggle with high inflation triggered by Trump's decision to go to war with Iran. Just 24% of Hispanic Americans approve of Trump's performance in the White House, the lowest share in either of Trump's two presidential terms. MANY INDEPENDENTS STILL UNDECIDED The poll gave numerous signs that Trump's low popularity was weighing heavily on his Republican Party, with registered voters preferring Democrats over Republicans by 44% to 37% less than a month before the November 3 election. Among independents, Democrats led 37% to 21%, with 28% of independent registered voters still undecided. Just 26% of Hispanic registered voters plan to vote Republican in the contest, which will determine control of both chambers of Congress during the last two years of Trump's current term. Some 52% of Hispanic voters plan to vote for Democrats, about double the level of support for Republicans and the largest Democratic advantage since Trump took office. Republicans are bracing for a rough performance in the congressional elections. Many analysts have predicted Democrats will take a majority in the House of Representatives, with control of the Senate also increasingly seen as up for grabs. Cost of living is the top issue on Americans' minds as they decide how they will vote next month, the Reuters/Ipsos poll found. Consumer inflation has spiked following a surge in gasoline and diesel prices brought on by the war with Iran that Trump launched in February. Republicans' advantage among older Americans has dwindled this year. Voters age 50 or older preferred Trump's party over the Democratic Party by just 2 percentage points — 44% to 42% — compared to an 8-point Republican advantage [USN:L6N3XG174 TEXT:"in December"]. The 50-and-older demographic is particularly important for midterm elections when older Americans historically have made up large shares of the electorate. Among voters under age 50, Democrats led by 18 points. The Reuters/Ipsos poll, which was conducted online and nationwide, surveyed 4,506 US adults and had a margin of error of about two percentage points.

item.title: US closes review of US airlines' data privacy without seeking penalties
item.description: The US Transportation Department has closed a Biden-era review of airlines' data privacy practices without imposing penalties, according to a memo seen by Reuters on Monday, despite lawmaker complaints that carriers failed to safeguard and misused the information.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The US Transportation Department has closed a Biden-era review of airlines' data privacy practices without imposing penalties, according to a memo seen by Reuters on Monday, despite lawmaker complaints that carriers failed to safeguard and misused the information. USDOT, which did not immediately comment Monday, said in the memo dated September 4 that it comprehensively evaluated the 10 biggest airlines' data privacy and "identified no violations of applicable laws or departmental policies." Then-Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg in March 2024 opened a review of how US airlines collect and use passenger information. Senator Ron Wyden, who has urged USDOT to address privacy concerns, said, "DOT claims that merely having a privacy policy and training is good enough, despite clear evidence of privacy abuses." In August, Wyden and Representative Shontel Brown said the Drug Enforcement Administration paid airline employees millions of dollars to obtain some Americans’ data. A database jointly owned by big US airlines has also sold passenger records to government agencies like the IRS without warrants or court oversight, they said. The department's memo said US airlines should avoid setting pricing based on individual data. It reminded airlines of ongoing responsibilities "to safeguard passenger data, adhere to published privacy policies, and prevent unlawful discrimination in dynamic pricing practices." Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said last year he would quickly investigate any personalized pricing. Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) has repeatedly denied it uses AI to set individualized prices.

item.title: Pennsylvania measles cases rise to 1,004 as outbreak spreads
item.description: Pennsylvania's health department reported 1,004 measles cases as of Monday, as the state grapples with a fast-growing outbreak.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pennsylvania's health department reported 1,004 measles cases as of Monday, as the state grapples with a fast-growing outbreak. Five Pennsylvania residents have [USN:L4N45M1NB TEXT:"died"] after contracting the highly contagious disease, as cases in the US reach their highest level in more than three decades. The Pennsylvania measles cases include 198 hospitalizations, according to the health department's website Lancaster county remains the hardest-hit area in the state with 391 cases All five people who have died from the disease in Pennsylvania this year were unvaccinated The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention has confirmed only [USN:L4N45L13A TEXT:"two measles-related deaths"] in the country this year, without naming the states The CDC has recorded 3,887 measles cases in 2026 so far — the most since the major resurgence between 1989 and 1991, when 55,000 infections and 123 deaths were recorded The CDC has said it was working with state epidemiologists on a standard definition for measles-related deaths Measles is a highly contagious viral disease but preventable with the measles, mumps and rubella vaccine, which is 97% effective after two doses

item.title: McDonald's hit with class action alleging AI-powered menu price-fixing
item.description: McDonald's has been sued in federal court in Chicago in a proposed nationwide class action alleging the fast-food company illegally coordinates menu prices across its franchises and company-owned restaurants through an AI-powered pricing system.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella
item.content:encoded: McDonald's (MCD.N) has been sued in federal court in Chicago in a proposed nationwide class action alleging the fast-food company illegally coordinates menu prices across its franchises and company-owned restaurants through an AI-powered pricing system. The lawsuit , filed on Friday, said McDonald’s violated US antitrust law by conspiring with independent franchisees to fix prices using algorithms trained on nonpublic data. Reuters [USN:L6N45K103 TEXT:"reported last week"] that McDonald’s pricing engine uses machine-learning algorithms to continually analyze data from millions of daily transactions across its nearly 14,000 restaurants. The lawsuit cited the Reuters article, which said other fast-food companies are also turning to AI to help with pricing and other operations. "Independent businesses must set their prices independently," the lawsuit said. McDonald’s, in a statement on Monday, called the allegations speculative and uninformed. "AI does not set the price of a Big Mac or any other menu item," the company said. It said franchisees make their own pricing decisions, and that the use of pricing recommendation tools and analytics is widespread across industries. US plaintiffs have filed a wave of class actions in recent years alleging that companies used algorithms or AI to illegally coordinate prices for hotel rooms, apartment rentals and other purchases. Lark Turner, a lawyer for the plaintiff, said in a statement, that McDonald's is "leveraging its troves of data and its franchised system to nickel-and-dime consumers down to the last French fry." The plaintiff, an Illinois resident, is seeking to represent a class of potentially millions of McDonald's customers, the lawsuit said.

item.title: トタルＣＥＯ、「不測の事態への備え」重視へ 必要時調達から転換
item.description: [ロンドン ５日] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ロンドン　５日] - 仏石油大手トタルエナジーズのパトリック・プヤンヌ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は５日、激動の世界でより多くの機会を追求する方針を示し、「ジャスト・イン・タイム（必要な時に必要なものを確保する）」から「ジャスト・イン・ケース（不測の事態に備える）」へ計画の立て方を転換する必要があると述べた。

プヤンヌ氏はロンドンで開催された「エネルギー・インテリジェンス」会議で、世界的なエネルギー資産ポートフォリオを持つ大手統合企業は、現在進行中の中東戦争のような局面で有用なビジネスモデルだと語った。また、中東という地域に対しこれまで以上にコミットしており、輸出ルートにより重点を置いているとの見方も示した。

トタルエナジーズの利益は今年に入って急拡大しており、ライバル企業のシェルやＢＰも同様に、イラン戦争に起因するエネルギー供給逼迫（ひっぱく）の中で、トレーディング部門から数十億ドルの収益を上げている。

Oct 5 : Washington Capitals captain Alex Ovechkin will retire after the 2026-27 NHL season, the league's all-time goal-scoring leader said on Monday, calling time on one of the sport's most extraordinary careers after more than two decades. Ovechkin propelled himself to the top of multiple all-time NHL records after joining the league in 2005, ranking first in 40-goal seasons (14) and power-play goals (331). He broke Wayne Gretzky's all-time goal-scoring record last year when he netted his 895th, a mark once thought untouchable. "My family and I decided this summer that this will be my final year in the NHL," the 41-year-old Russian said in a statement. "I love this game so much, but I know in my heart it’s the right decision." Ovechkin informed his teammates of his decision in a locker- room address, with their opening home game of the season set for Wednesday.

"I am excited about this season with my teammates, and we will do everything we can to make this year special," said Ovechkin.  "I am going to enjoy every moment with my family, my boys, our fans and everyone who has been part of my hockey career." The former first overall draft pick for the Capitals is the longest-contracted professional athlete ever in Washington DC, and delivered the team their first Stanley Cup championship in 2018. Ovechkin courted controversy in the off-season when he agreed to appear in a political advertisement in support of the United Russia party, which has the backing of Russian President Vladimir Putin. He later told reporters of his decision: "I support my country." But the forward has long held the overwhelming affections of the US capital's fans and ticket prices for the team's final regular-season home game in April soared on secondary sales platforms after his announcement. "It was important for me to make this announcement before our first home game, so I have the chance to thank all the people around the game, everyone who has been so important to me and my family and helped me through good times and tough losses," said Ovechkin. "I wouldn’t have been able to achieve everything I have in my life without them." His departure will bring to an end one of the sport's most compelling rivalries, with his multi-year, back-and-forth battle against Canada's Sidney Crosby captivating fans. Crosby was drafted first overall the year after Ovechkin. "It's tough - you come into the league at 18 years old and before we even met we were kind of built up against each other," Pittsburgh Penguins captain Crosby told reporters. "Over the years, obviously, have developed a friendship with him and have a ton of respect for him."

Source: Reuters

item.description: ＜ロンドン株式市場＞ まちまちで取引を終えた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．２...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（5日） 3:40 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞　まちまちで取引を終えた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は続伸。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．２９％安と反落した。    中東からの原油輸出量が増加傾向にあるほか、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）が協調して石油備蓄を放出することを決め、ブレント原油先物価格は下落した。ただ、イエメン暫定政府軍と親イラン武装組織フーシ派の対立が続き、警戒感は残っている。    銅価格の値上がりを受け、ＦＴＳＥ３５０種鉱業株指数は１．６５％上昇。石油・ガス生産を手がけるイサカ・エナジーは２．２％高。カナダの企業から海洋石油資産を買い取ることで合意し、買い材料視された。通信大手ＢＴグループは１．４％上昇した。    英国のサービス部門の調査では、燃料高の影響で９月にコスト圧力が強まった。ＬＳＥＧによると、イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が１１月会合で利上げを決定することが市場でほぼ確実視されている。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞　続伸して取引を終えた。銀行株を買い戻す動きが目立った。フランス財政への懸念から、フランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は０．８０％安。一方、スペインのサンチェス首相が解散総選挙の実施を発表する中、金融関連の比重が高いスペインのＩＢＥＸ指数は１．１２％上昇した。    フランス１０年債利回りは２００８年以来の高水準付近で推移している。    ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種銀行株指数は１．３３％高だった。    資源株指数は１．５３％、石油・ガス株指数は１．０８％それぞれ上昇した。    一方、工業株指数は０．７２％安。米ソフトウエア企業の買収合意を発表したフランスの配電・制御機器大手シュナイダー・エレクトリックは１０．０％急落した。ソフトウエア事業に支払う上乗せ額を含めた買収金額への懸念が背景にあるとみられる。    オランダの塗料メーカー、アクゾノーベルは１．８％上昇。東南アジアの建築用塗料事業を日本ペイントホールディングスに売却することで合意した。    ユーロ圏の９月総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）改定値は前月から上昇した。インフレ懸念がある中でも、需要が堅調だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　フランス国債利回りが小幅低下し、ドイツ国債との利回り格差が縮小した。ただ、仏国債利回りとスプレッドはいずれも、足元と比べて依然として高い水準にある。    先週後半、インフレと財政不安の高まりから安全資産を求める動きが広がり、ドイツ国債とオランダ国債の利回りは低下。一方、フランス国債利回りは急上昇し、イタリア国債利回りもそれに追随するように上昇した。フランス国債は、高い債務水準と２０２７年の大統領選挙を控えた政治リスクの高まりを背景に、大きな売り圧力にさらされている。     ただ、５日はこうした動きが一服。フランス１０年債利回りは１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．８６％となった。独仏１０年債利回り格差は縮小し、１３８ｂｐとなった。     ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは３ｂｐ上昇の３．４９％。    イタリア１０年債利回りは４ｂｐ上昇の４．６６％。    スペイン１０年債利回りは約５ｂｐ上昇の４．１３％となった。スペインのサンチェス首相は５日、１１月２９日に総選挙を実施すると発表した。先週、政府の主要な住宅関連政令が議会で否決されたことを受け、議会を解散して改めて国民に信を問う。    市場が織り込む欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が１０月の理事会で利上げを行う確率は約２０％、１２月までの利上げ確率は約８０％となっている。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場：[DE/BJ]

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 5 : The Wikimedia Foundation, which operates the online encyclopedia Wikipedia, says that heavy traffic from OpenAI's rogue agents was possibly tied to disruption that its data service experienced in May. Here are some details: • In a blog post issued on Monday, Wikimedia said it could confirm "that we have discovered some activity by these 'rogue' OpenAI agents on Wikimedia platforms," including a May incident that resulted in a "partial outage" of its Wikidata Query Service. • Wikimedia said the disruption seemed to have been triggered as the agents visited millions of pages and made hundreds of thousands of data queries.

• Wikimedia also said that the OpenAI agents made unauthorized edits to Wikimedia wiki sites, including "potentially malicious edits" to a citation tool which the foundation said were likely intended to hijack it. • Wikimedia said its Etherpad note-taking tool was also hit by malicious activity from OpenAI's agents. • OpenAI did not immediately return an email seeking comment. The company has been scrambling to get its arms around the full scope of its rogue agent activity, Reuters has previously reported.

Oct 5 : Bahrain have parted ways with manager Dragan Talajic by mutual agreement following the defending champions' early exit from the Gulf Cup, the country's football association (BFA) said on Monday. The 61-year-old Croatian led Bahrain to the title in 2024. However, they lost all their matches in the group stage of this year's tournament. Bahrain are set to compete against Uzbekistan, North Korea and Jordan in Group B of the 2027 Asian Cup, which will be held in Saudi Arabia.

item.title: Report: Panthers captain Aleksander Barkov (leg) out 10-12 weeks
item.description: Florida Panthers captain Aleksander Barkov is set to be sidelined for 10 to 12 weeks with the left leg injury that landed him on long-term injured reserve, according to a report by Locked On Panthers on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Florida Panthers captain Aleksander Barkov is set to be sidelined for 10 to 12 weeks with the left leg injury that landed him on long-term injured reserve, according to a report by Locked On Panthers on Monday. However, Panthers coach Paul Maurice appeared to refute the report when asked about Barkov's timeline later Monday. "Do not bet your hard-earned money on that one," Maurice said, adding that Barkov is still meeting with doctors and the team will have another update Tuesday. "I know you can bet on everything these days, but hang on to your cash. ... If I don't know, nobody else does." Barkov sustained the injury during the second period of Florida's 4-3 overtime loss to the San Jose Sharks on Thursday. He was vying for the puck along the boards when he was pushed by Sharks defenseman Darnell Nurse, causing Barkov to fall to the ice with his knee at an awkward angle. Barkov remained on the ice for several moments before retreating to the locker room. It was just Barkov's second game back after he missed the entire 2025-26 season due to torn ligaments in his right knee. He was placed on long-term IR Saturday, meaning he'll be forced to miss a minimum of 10 games. The reported timeline would align with Barkov returning to action in mid-December or early January. Barkov, 31, is a two-time Stanley Cup winner and a three-time Selke Trophy recipient (2021, 2024, 2025) as the NHL's best defensive forward, leading the Panthers to consecutive Stanley Cups in 2023-24 and 2024-25. He boasts franchise records for goals (286), assists (496), points (782) and games played (806) since being selected with the second overall pick of the 2013 NHL Draft. --Field Level Media

item.title: Packers LB Edgerrin Cooper (Achilles) out for season
item.description: Green Bay Packers linebacker Edgerrin Cooper will miss the remainder of the season after an MRI revealed Monday he has a torn left Achilles tendon.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Green Bay Packers linebacker Edgerrin Cooper will miss the remainder of the season after an MRI revealed Monday he has a torn left Achilles tendon. "He's a tough guy to lose," Packers coach Matt LaFleur said Monday. "We all saw what he was able to do in basically a half of football and the player he is. My heart hurts for him, his recovery, and what he's going through." Cooper was carted off the field in Sunday's 17-14 win against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers after he went to the ground untouched immediately after a snap in the third quarter. He grabbed at his left ankle as the play proceeded. In the first half at Tampa, Cooper had nine tackles, an interception, a quarterback sack and one pass defensed. Cooper, 24, had 30 tackles and an interception in four games this season. The second-round draft pick out of Texas A&M in 2024 has 235 tackles with seven sacks in 34 games (24 starts) in three seasons with Green Bay. The Packers filled Cooper's spot with Isaiah McDuffie and Ty'Ron Hopper for the remainder of the game. There are questions about what the Packers might do at running back with Chris Brooks (ankle) undergoing tests Monday, according to LaFleur. He had four carries for 30 yards -- including a 27-yarder -- before he left the game. --Field Level Media

item.title: After notching two jet fighter contracts, Boeing could be turning the page
item.description: Boeing's won the contract for the US Navy's next-generation fighter due to years of investment, decades of experience building carrier-based jets and a design approach that closely matched the Pentagon's push for easier-to-upgrade aircraft, according to people familiar with the competition.
item.dc:creator: Dan Catchpole
item.content:encoded: Boeing's (BA.N) won the contract for the [USN:FWN45L1T6 TEXT:"US Navy's next-generation fighter"] due to years of investment, decades of experience building carrier-based jets and a design approach that closely matched the Pentagon's push for easier-to-upgrade aircraft, according to people familiar with the competition. Last week's win marks Boeing's second major fighter jet victory after securing the Air Force's F-47 program last year. The aerospace company bested rivals Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) and Northrop Grumman (NOC.N) for the Navy's F/A-XX fighter contract, worth more than $20 billion in its initial development phase. The victories give the company's defense, space and security division an opportunity to turn the corner on years of costly overruns, delays on military aircraft programs and the high-profile setbacks of its Starliner spacecraft. "Now all of a sudden, it controls the next half century and beyond of US tactical aircraft," said Richard Aboulafia, managing director of AeroDynamic Advisory. "There's nothing like that in history." The Pentagon required competitors for the F-47 and F/A-XX programs — Boeing, Lockheed Martin and Northrop Grumman — to use common design standards to make later upgrades and modifications easier, in order to respond quickly to changing technology and evolving threats. "All the industry players did what they were supposed to, but there were varying degrees of embrace and enthusiasm," said a former Pentagon official familiar with the competitions. "Boeing's embrace was effective." The company also distinguished itself through its use of digital design tools, making it easier for engineers, military officials and maintainers to test changes and refine the aircraft during development, the official said. The Pentagon and Lockheed Martin declined to comment. Northrop Grumman said in a statement that it "offered a highly survivable, digitally advanced sixth-generation fighter" in the F/A-XX competition, and it has "requested a debriefing from the US Navy" on the selection process and award decision, a requirement for appealing the Pentagon's decision. NO GUARANTEE OF SUCCESS Winning the programs does not guarantee financial success for Boeing. Several analysts said the outcome will depend heavily on the terms of the contracts, which neither Boeing nor the Defense Department would comment on. Boeing has lost $20.5 billion on five fixed-price development programs that left it responsible for cost overruns — the KC-46 tanker, T-7 trainer, MQ-25 refueling drone, Air Force One replacement and Starliner programs. "If it is fixed price, that's a warning sign," Aboulafia said. CEO Kelly Ortberg has said Boeing will not pursue similar fixed-price development contracts in the future, as it tries to leave those expensive mistakes in the past. Few details about either aircraft have been released. The F-47 is expected to fly in 2028 and enter service in 2029, with the Air Force planning to buy at least 185 aircraft to replace the F-22. Even less is known about the F/A-XX, which is expected to enter service in the 2030s and eventually replace the Navy's F/A-18 fleet. While the development contracts are each worth more than $20 billion, the production work could generate hundreds of billions of dollars over the lifetime of the aircraft. BETTING BIG ON FIGHTERS After losing the F-35 contract to Lockheed Martin in 2001, Boeing kept its engineering expertise with work on classified projects, as well as F-15 and F/A-18 upgrades. The F-15EX upgrade was considered so good that the Air Force resumed buying the jet years after it had stopped. After COVID, Boeing spent billions of dollars on new production facilities, engineering capabilities and digital design tools in a bid to win the next generation of US fighter jets. Boeing argues that developing two advanced fighters in tandem lowers risk due to shared technologies and design features. "Delivering two advanced fighters in parallel was always our plan, and we invested accordingly," Boeing Defense CEO Steve Parker said in a statement. Ortberg tapped the veteran of Boeing's fighter programs to lead the defense division in 2024. While important differences remain, both the F-47 and F/A-XX are meant to establish air superiority alongside autonomous drones in a potential conflict with China, said Roman Schweizer, a defense analyst at TD Cowen. (This story has been refiled to remove 'naval' from the headline.)

item.title: ガソリン高騰、民主党とウクライナの製油所攻撃に責任＝トランプ氏
item.description: [ワシントン ５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ５日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は５日、イラン戦争に起因するエネルギー価格の上昇圧力が高まる中、ガソリン価格の高騰について民主党とウクライナによるロシアの製油所攻撃に責任があると述べた。

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で「ガソリン価格を押し上げているのはもはやホルムズ海峡ではない。現在、記録的な原油量がほぼ毎日、市場に出回っているからだ」と主張。その上で「原因は『製油所』だ。ウクライナによってロシアの製油所は爆破され、カリフォルニア州など（民主党優勢の）青い州では、『愚かな民主党』によって米国の製油所が閉鎖されている」と述べた。

イランがホルムズ海峡を事実上封鎖して以降、エネルギー価格は急騰している。また、ウクライナによるロシアのエネルギーインフラへの攻撃も、特にディーゼル燃料の価格高騰を招いている。

item.title: Russian attack kills 6 in Ukraine's Kharkiv, shatters residences
item.description: Russian bombs struck a residential area of Ukraine's northeastern city of Kharkiv on Monday, killing six people, injuring nearly 60 and shattering apartment buildings, officials said.
item.dc:creator: Vitalii Hnidyi
item.content:encoded: Russian bombs struck a residential area of Ukraine's northeastern city of Kharkiv on Monday, killing six people, injuring nearly 60 and shattering apartment buildings, officials said. Oleh Syniehubov, governor of the northeastern region, said on Telegram that three bombs had hit different areas of the city. He said 59 people were injured, with 30 of them being treated in hospital, three in a serious condition. Three of the injured were children. Mayor Ihor Terehov said emergency crews had recovered three bodies from rubble. Facades and balconies on residential buildings were badly damaged and apartments inside were smashed. Rescue workers led stunned residents out of buildings, guiding them carefully around piles of rubble. "We saw two wounded neighbours covered in blood. My daughter went outside, and our cat ran away," resident Viktoriia Nahornyak told Reuters Television over the wail of an air raid siren. "I only grabbed my documents and went outside in the clothes I'm wearing right now," she said. One resident was found dead in his bed. Another body lay on the ground, covered with a blanket. Officials said warehouses were also damaged in the strike. Kharkiv, located 30 km (18 miles) from the Russian border, is Ukraine's second-largest city. From the outset of the war in February 2022, it has withstood sustained Russian attacks and suffered considerable damage. Elsewhere, a Russian drone struck an apartment building in the southern Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia, triggering a fire and injuring three people who were initially trapped on the building's ninth floor, Regional Governor Ivan Fedorov said. And Russian air strikes killed one person in Sloviansk, one of several front-line cities in Ukraine's Donetsk Region that Russian forces aim to capture in their slow advance westward through the broader Donbas region.

item.title: 原油高、27年以降も継続へ 石油大手幹部が供給制約指摘
item.description: [ロンドン ５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ロンドン ５日 ロイター] - 石油業界の幹部らは５日、ロンドンで開催された「エネルギー・インテリジェンス」会議で、海上輸送の停滞や製油所の大幅減産、在庫の取り崩しにより、世界の原油価格は２０２７年以降も高止まりするとの見通しを示した。

イランが原油輸送の要衝であるホルムズ海峡を事実上封鎖して以降、同海峡を経由する輸出が滞っている。また、石油・ガスインフラへの攻撃が影響をさらに深刻化させ、生産を妨げるとともに、原油や石油製品の輸出の混乱に拍車をかけている。

マレーシアの国営石油・天然ガス会社ペトロナスのテンク・ムハンマド・タウフィック最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は「年末までの大半の期間、そして恐らく２７年も大混乱が続くと思う」と述べた。

サウジアラビアの国有石油会社サウジアラムコのアミン・ナセルＣＥＯは、原油・精製燃料の供給引き締まりはさらに深刻化する見通しで、緊急措置として取り崩された世界の備蓄を回復させるには２年かかる可能性があると述べた。

ナセル氏はまた、ホルムズ海峡が完全に再開され、信頼が回復するまでは、原油市場で需給逼迫が強まるというのが現実だと指摘した。

＜石油製品、日量６００万バレル不足＞

クウェート石油公社（ＫＰＣ）のナワフ・サバハＣＥＯは、イラン戦争の影響で世界の石油製品供給が日量６００万バレル不足しているため、世界市場への石油製品供給を増やし、中東の製油所を全面稼働に戻すことに重点を置いていると述べた。「中東湾岸地域で停止している精製能力を補うだけの余力は世界にない」と語った。

クウェートの原油生産量は日量約２６０万バレルから２００万バレルに減少したが、２０２６年の原油輸出は戦争による混乱にもかかわらず、日量約１００万バレルを維持しているという。

＜需要回復は２８年以降に＞

米石油・ガス大手コノコフィリップスのライアン・ランス会長は、世界の石油需要が回復するのは、２８年か２９年になる可能性があるとの見通しを提示。ただ、その後は増加するとした。原油価格の下限が１バレル＝７０ドル前後まで上昇すると予想しており、米原油指標ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（ＷＴＩ）のミッドサイクル価格は同６５─７０ドルになると見込んでいると述べた。

５日の取引では、北海ブレント先物が１００ドルをやや上回り、米ＷＴＩ先物は９０ドル近辺で推移している。

item.title: Cenovus strikes $5.7B deal to buy Athabasca Oil, expand production
item.description: Cenovus Energy said on Monday it would buy Athabasca Oil in a $5.7 billion (US$4 billion) cash-and-stock deal, cementing its position as one of Canada’s largest oilsands producers at a time the ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: Cenovus Energy said on Monday it would buy Athabasca Oil in a $5.7 billion (US$4 billion) cash-and-stock deal, cementing its position as one of Canada’s largest oilsands producers at a time the country is aiming to boost crude output. The acquisition of Athabasca — one of the last remaining independent companies in Alberta’s increasingly consolidated oilsands sector — comes a year after Cenovus’ $8.6 billion purchase of MEG Energy. The deal highlights a stronger growth outlook from Canadian oilsands companies in the wake of sweeping regulatory and policy changes by Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government aimed at removing barriers to investment by fossil fuel producers. It adds about 45,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day to Cenovus’ thermal oil sands production, and the company said the assets could be expanded to produce 115,000 barrels per day by 2032. Cenovus’ total upstream production in the second quarter of 2026 was approximately 970,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day. The transaction, expected to close in December, will also give Cenovus full ownership of Athabasca’s subsidiary Duvernay Energy, strengthening its position in the oil-rich Kaybob Duvernay area, where it sees potential to grow output to 20,000 boepd. Shares of Cenovus were down 2.8 per cent in morning trading, while Athabasca shares jumped 14.3 per cent to C$12.17 following the roughly $12-per-share offer, a 13.4 per cent premium to the stock’s last closing price on Friday. Cole Smead, CEO of Smead Capital, who owns Cenovus shares in his portfolio, described the company’s move as aggressive and said it was paying a high price for the assets. But he also said it spoke to Cenovus’ confidence in its ability to advance proposed new oil sands growth projects at Athabasca’s Corner and Leismer sites. “It’s an expensive move, but it’s an optimistic move,” Smead said. “If they’re going to go out and grow production at Athabasca, it means they like the future.” Cenovus CEO Jon McKenzie told analysts on a conference call that Cenovus is contemplating advancing the Corner project three years earlier than Athabasca’s existing development plan, to produce approximately 40,000 bpd by 2032. Carney said last week his government will fast-track the approval process for a new 1-million-bpd proposed crude oil export pipeline to the Pacific coast, which could allow Canadian oil sands producers to significantly expand production. But Canada’s largest oilsands companies, including Cenovus, have not yet made a final investment decision to go ahead with a large-scale carbon capture and storage project that Carney has said is a condition of the new pipeline going ahead. Athabasca shareholders will receive 0.264 Cenovus shares for each share held, valuing the deal at about C$5.76 billion, according to a Reuters calculation based on Athabasca’s 480.34 million shares outstanding per data compiled by LSEG. (Reporting by Pranav Mathur in Bengaluru and Amanda Stephenson in Calgary; Editing by Shreya Biswas, Shinjini Ganguli and Nia Williams)

item.title: トルコ9月インフレ率29.7％、約4年ぶり30％割れ 食品価格下落で
item.description: [イスタンブール ５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[イスタンブール ５日 ロイター] - トルコ統計局が５日発表した９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、前年同月からの伸び率が２９．７３％となり、３０％を割り込んだ。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は３０．３％で、８月は３１．５１％だった。食品価格の下落を要因として指摘する声が出ている。前月比の伸び率は１．８４％で８月から横ばいだった。

シムシェキ財務相は、インフレ率が３０％を下回るのは２０２１年１１月以来だと指摘。サービス部門の物価上昇が鈍化し、商品（コモディティー）価格への圧力が弱まることで、来年にかけてインフレ鈍化につながるとの見方を示した。

トルコ中央銀行は８月発表のインフレ報告で、２６年末のインフレ率見通しを２８％に引き上げたものの、年末の暫定インフレ目標は２４％に据え置いている。中銀は９月の会合で、主要政策金利を３７％に据え置いた。据え置きは５会合連続で、今後は金融緩和局面が始まるとの見方が強い。

９月のＣＰＩは、教育費が前月比１４．２％上昇したほか、衣料品や運輸費、住宅価格も上昇。一方、食品価格は０．２％下落した。

item.title: Rendimientos de bonos Tesoro EEUU a largo plazo suben por percepción pesimista sobre la deuda
item.description: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense subieron en su mayoría el lunes, debido al pesimismo que prevalecía en el mercado de deuda, mientras los inversores sopesan las perspectivas de un alza de las tasas de interés.
item.dc:creator: Caroline Valetkevitch
item.content:encoded: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense subieron en su mayoría el lunes, debido al pesimismo que prevalecía en el mercado de deuda, mientras los inversores sopesan las perspectivas de un alza de las tasas de interés. Los rendimientos se mantuvieron al alza después de que datos económicos sugirieron que la inflación podría permanecer alta hasta 2027. Un informe del Instituto de Gerencia y Abastecimiento (ISM, por su sigla en inglés) mostró que la actividad del sector servicios estadounidense se ralentizó en septiembre, mientras que la fuerte demanda interna ejerció presión sobre las cadenas de suministro e impulsó los precios que pagan las empresas por los insumos a máximos de más de cuatro años. "No hubo nada que impulsara los rendimientos en la dirección contraria", dijo Jim Barnes, director de renta fija de Bryn Mawr Trust. Las preocupaciones fiscales en el extranjero también siguieron lastrando el mercado de bonos estadounidense, añadió. "Es ese asunto general el que se cierne sobre el mercado de bonos: las preocupaciones fiscales en todo el mundo en diversos mercados desarrollados", explicó. "Cuando surge en algún lugar… empieza a influir en los mercados de bonos de todo el mundo, y hoy estamos viendo algo de eso". Los precios de los bonos han caído en todo el mundo, lo que ha provocado un aumento de los rendimientos, y suscitado preocupación por la deuda pública en Francia y de otros países. Los rendimientos en España subieron el lunes después de que el presidente del Gobierno, Pedro Sánchez, convocó elecciones anticipadas para el 29 de noviembre en un intento de reforzar su mandato, tras el rechazo por parte del Parlamento de los decretos del Gobierno sobre vivienda la semana pasada, en un contexto de las protestas. Las probabilidades de una subida de tasas de interés este mes se vieron reducidas por los recientes datos de inflación inferiores a lo esperado en agosto y julio, así como por la desaceleración del crecimiento del empleo no agrícola en Estados Unidos durante septiembre. El viernes, los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense revirtieron sus caídas anteriores, a pesar de un informe de empleo de septiembre que resultó ser más débil de lo esperado. Según la herramienta FedWatch de CME Group, los operadores estimaban una probabilidad de aproximadamente el 76% de que las tasas se mantengan sin cambios en la reunión de este mes. Las expectativas de una subida en diciembre superan el 80%. El mes pasado, la Reserva Federal subió las tasas de interés por primera vez desde 2023 en un intento por controlar la inflación. El rendimiento del bono del Tesoro estadounidense a 10 años subió 3,4 puntos básicos, al 5,311%. El rendimiento del bono a 30 años ganó 3,2 puntos básicos, al 5,662%. En la sesión, el bono a 10 años alcanzó el 5,3493% y el de 30 años el 5,7029%, ambos nuevos máximos en 24 años. La diferencia entre los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a dos y diez años , considerado un indicador de las expectativas económicas, se situó en 48,8 puntos básicos, tras haber estado en 49,70, su nivel más alto desde el 21 de agosto. El retorno del bono del Tesoro estadounidense a dos años , que normalmente se mueve en línea con las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal, bajó 0,4 puntos básicos, al 4,821%.

item.title: FTC says it urged US hospitals to provide prompt, accurate pricing information to patients
item.description: The US Federal Trade Commission said on Monday it has sent letters to 24 of the country's largest healthcare services companies about their legal obligation to provide pricing information to patients.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Federal Trade Commission said on Monday it has sent letters to 24 of the country's largest healthcare services companies about their legal obligation to provide pricing information to patients. The commission said in a statement that "failing to do so can be an unfair or deceptive practice."

item.title: 黒海の貨物船火災で2人死亡、ウクライナはロシアのドローン攻撃と主張
item.description: [５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[５日 ロイター] - ルーマニア政府は５日、ルーマニア領海外の黒海を航行していた貨物船で火災が発生し、少なくとも２人が死亡したと明らかにした。ルーマニアは火災の原因に言及していないが、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、ロシアのドローン（無人機）攻撃により火災が発生したとしている。

ルーマニア当局によると、火災が発生したロヤド・ママドフ号は沈没し、乗組員のうち１１人が救助された。

これについて、ゼレンスキー大統領は「トルコ企業が所有し、トウモロコシを積載して中立水域を航行していた民間船舶がロシアのドローン２機による攻撃を受けた。アゼルバイジャン人とインド人の乗組員が乗っていた」とＸに投稿。「船長の死亡が確認された。１１人が救助され、そのうち１人は負傷している」とした。

この件についてロシア当局は今のところコメントしていない。ただ、ロシア国防省は定例報告で、貨物船２隻を攻撃したと表明していた。

ロヤド・ママドフ号はセントクリストファー・ネービス船籍で、船舶追跡サイト「VesselFinder」によると、ウクライナ南部イズマール港を出港した後、イタリア北部ラベンナに向かっていた。

ルーマニアは北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）加盟国で、ウクライナと６１４キロの国境を接している。ロシアによるウクライナ全面侵攻開始後、ロシアのドローンがルーマニア領空に侵入する事例が相次いでいる。

item.title: Trump to issue order expanding access to tax-exempt diesel fuel, sources say
item.description: US President Donald Trump is preparing an executive order to expand access to tax-exempt diesel that will be unveiled as soon as Monday, two sources familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Jarrett Renshaw
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump is preparing an executive order to expand access to tax-exempt diesel that will be unveiled as soon as Monday, two sources familiar with the matter said. High diesel prices, which shot to a record of about $6.50 a gallon last month, are a risk to Trump ahead of the Nov. 3 elections. Prices for the fuel integral to trucking goods have risen in response to the wars in Iran and Ukraine which have led to attacks on refineries in Russia and the Middle East. The order is expected to contain a variety of ways to expand access to diesel which could include making more available so-called red dye diesel fuel which is used by the agriculture industry and by some off-road vehicles, the sources said. A third source said the order will likely direct the US Department of Transportation to coordinate with states to waive taxes on road diesel. G7 countries announced last week that they would release 100 million barrels of diesel, after pressure from Trump who had considered banning US exports of the fuel. But it was not clear how much of that release would be entirely new supplies or compliance with a global agreement in March. Bloomberg first reported the news on the executive order.

item.title: Liverpool match looms but Man City will know what to expect at Anfield
item.description: Manchester City face a hostile reception at Liverpool on Sunday in their first game since being found guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, though how much the verdict will affect the leaders remains unclear.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manchester City face a hostile reception at Liverpool on Sunday in their first game since being found guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules, though how much the verdict will affect the leaders remains unclear. Fan chatrooms have been humming with opinion and invective but that is nothing new when it comes to relations between the old rivals. The "[USN:L6N45L10S TEXT:"sham" commercial contract case"] has hung over the Premier League for years and may rumble on for some time yet after City filed an appeal. Just how much it spills over into the stands at Anfield, and grounds beyond that over the course of the season, remains to be seen. "If they want an understanding of how angry the game is going to be, then Anfield will tell them like you would never believe," former Manchester United captain and England defender Gary Neville declared recently on The Overlap podcast. "I suspect there may be banners, there will certainly be chanting. There will be a reception like you have never seen for them at Anfield...it will be a brutal day." Merseyside Police said there would be an appropriate policing operation in place on the day. CITY CHARGED Other commentators said that Liverpool supporters had been calling City cheats since they were charged by the Premier League [USN:L4N3P11BV TEXT:"in February 2023."] "Man City players already know what rival fans will do amid charges fallout," read a headline in the Manchester Evening news on Monday. "City players won't necessarily be walking into anything new when they resume their club duties this weekend," wrote the paper's chief City reporter. "It is not going to be pretty, but it will be a surprise if it catches the players off guard given how used to the abuse they are." City are unbeaten and three points clear of champions Arsenal at the top of the table, five ahead of third-placed Brighton & Hove Albion. They are likely to still be top by the time of Sunday's match even if Arsenal beat Leeds United on Saturday, given the four-goal difference between them. One contributor on the lfcreds.com website said the best response was for Liverpool to beat City on the field and the fans to make their feelings heard inside Anfield on the day. "Could this be one of the first games that pretty much everyone in the country wants us to win?," asked another.

item.title: 米軍、アリゾナ州で対ドローン演習 侵入件数増加に対応
item.description:
Mike Blake
［ユマ（米アリゾナ州） ５日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Mike Blake

［ユマ（米アリゾナ州）　５日　ロイター］ - 米陸軍は９月に西部アリゾナ州でレーダーや迎撃用無人機（ドローン）、自律型砲撃システムを用い、小型無人航空機を検知、追跡、破壊する演習を実施した。ドローンへの防衛対応力を強化する構えで、対ロシア戦闘でのウクライナ軍のドローン活用の実績を踏まえ、革新的な技術を取り入れる狙いもある。

メキシコ国境の統合部隊幹部は記者団に、過去３０日間で３７８件のドローン侵入を検知し、侵入件数は増加傾向にあると指摘した。陸軍関係者によると、麻薬カルテルが使うメキシコ側からのドローンは、多くが市販のシステムを搭載し、監視カメラで、密輸や人身売買に関連する偵察に利用されているという。当局者によると、麻薬カルテルが運用するドローンは、ウクライナや中東で見られる軍事用ドローンに性能では劣るものの、装備の試験や訓練、システムの性能評価などを確かめる機会となっているという。

２０２２年のロシアによるウクライナ侵攻以降、ドローン新興企業などに数十億ドルの投資資金が集まっている。米国防総省もベンチャー投資資金が流れ込む防衛企業に関心を寄せている。

９月の演習では、ドローン開発会社アンドゥリルのドローンや、テレダインＦＬＩＲ製のレーダー・カメラ検知システム、アレン・コントロール・システムズの対ドローン自律型マシンガンのほか、パワラスが販売する迎撃ドローンが使われた。

item.title: フライドバイ事件、イラン関与の証拠見られずとバンス氏 トランプ氏は責任示唆
item.description: [ワシントン ５日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ５日 ロイター] - バンス米副大統領は５日、イスラエル行き旅客機で副操縦士が墜落を図ったとされる事件について、イランが関与したかどうかを示す決定的な証拠は確認されていないと述べた。

一方、トランプ大統領は、イランに責任があると考えているかとの質問に対し、個人的にはそう考えていると述べた。

事件は９月３０日、イスラエル・テルアビブ行きのアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）格安航空会社（ＬＣＣ）フライドバイ機で発生。副操縦士が飛行中に機長を刺して機体を墜落させようとしたとみられている。負傷した機長が操縦室のドアを解錠し、乗客らが副操縦士を取り押さえたため、同機はサウジアラビアに緊急着陸し、大惨事は回避された。

item.title: US to announce $150 million for Alaska power lines as Vance campaigns in Senate battleground
item.description: The US Energy Department will announce $150 million in new funding for power lines in Alaska on Monday as Vice President JD Vance visits the state, where Republicans are fighting to hold a critical Senate seat in the November midterm elections.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage
item.content:encoded: The US Energy Department will announce $150 million in new funding for power lines in Alaska on Monday as Vice President JD Vance visits the state, where Republicans are fighting to hold a critical Senate seat in the November midterm elections. Vance is set to rally voters for Republican Senator Dan Sullivan, who is locked in a tight reelection battle with Democrat Mary Peltola. Flipping the seat is key to the Democratic Party's strategy to take control of the US Senate, and recent polls have Peltola, a former member of the US House of Representatives, leading Sullivan. The energy plan is the latest in a series of economic and investment announcements President Donald Trump and his administration have highlighted ahead of the midterms amid voter concerns over the Iran war and high gasoline prices. Under the Energy Department plan, the Trump administration will tap federal funds to help construct 223 miles (359 km) of new electrical transmission lines linking the Beluga power station on Alaska's southern coast with Healy in the state's interior, an administration official told Reuters. The corridor between Beluga and Healy covers major ports and nearly three-quarters of the state's roughly 735,000-person population. The total cost of the project is $400 million, the official said. SOUTH KOREA BACKED ALASKA PIPELINE CONDITIONALLY A New York Times poll that concluded October 1 placed Peltola ahead by 7 percentage points. Other polls indicate the race is about even. Alaska, with its far-flung and rural population, is often difficult for pollsters to gauge. Trump [USN:L1N45M0IK TEXT:"unveiled plans"] last week for South Korea to invest some $200 billion in US projects, including for an Alaska liquefied natural gas pipeline. But Seoul quickly said the pipeline would only proceed if certain commercial and legal conditions were met. Both Sullivan and Peltola have made affordability — and energy — primary issues in their campaigns. Sullivan supports drilling for oil and gas in Alaska's protected wilderness and has called on Trump to ban diesel exports amid the economic fallout from conflict with Iran and the Russian war in Ukraine. Peltola has called for refining more oil and natural gas in Alaska but does not support drilling for resources in the environmentally fragile wilderness. She has also advocated for federal tax credits for solar, wind and hydropower projects.

item.title: US commodities regulator proposes new federal crypto oversight rules
item.description: The US commodities regulator proposed on Monday a new federal framework for cryptocurrency exchanges that offer leveraged digital asset trading, seeking to bring parts of the spot crypto market under federal oversight weeks after Congress failed to advance comprehensive crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Lang
item.content:encoded: The US commodities regulator proposed on Monday a new federal framework for cryptocurrency exchanges that offer leveraged digital asset trading, seeking to bring parts of the spot crypto market under federal oversight weeks after Congress failed to advance comprehensive crypto regulation. The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission's proposed rules would effectively allow US crypto exchanges to opt into a federal regulatory framework instead of relying primarily on a patchwork of state money-transmitter licenses, the agency said. The proposed rules make use of a specific authority the CFTC has to oversee margined or leveraged spot assets. The CFTC has long sought authority to regulate spot cryptocurrency markets — which currently operate in a regulatory grey area — but only Congress has the ability to provide the regulator with that purview. "For years, entrepreneurs building on the new frontier of finance faced uncertainty about whether there was a place for them in our markets. We are giving them an answer," said CFTC Chairman Michael Selig in a speech on Monday at an event in New York held by Fordham University's law school. RULES WOULD ESTABLISH NEW TRADING VENUE CATEGORY Under the proposed rules, the CFTC would establish a new category of CFTC-regulated trading venues called a "crypto asset market" for exchanges that offer leveraged or margined trading to retail customers. Those platforms would be subject to specific requirements including anti-market-manipulation controls and a "proof of reserves" obligation. The CFTC is also proposing that registered futures commission merchants intermediate customer trades on the new category of exchanges. The agency is not stipulating specific leverage limits, but any exchange offering a leveraged transaction would have to clear that product with CFTC staff, the agency said. The proposed rules come after Congress [USN:L1N4560M2 TEXT:"failed to advance"] a major crypto bill, called the Clarity Act, which would have created new rules for the $2 trillion cryptocurrency market, putting the industry on a firmer legal footing. One of the key components of the bill was the explicit authority for the CFTC to police the spot crypto market. The impasse in Congress has put the onus on US President Donald Trump's crypto-friendly regulators, particularly the Securities and Exchange Commission and the CFTC, to give the industry [USN:L1N39023I TEXT:"the regulatory clarity"] it has long argued it lacks. Still, [USN:L1N4490UR TEXT:"analysts have said"] that without legislation, regulations could be vulnerable to the shifting political climate and court challenges, creating lingering hazards for the crypto industry.

item.title: 中銀の今後の危機対応、債務増や市場変化で複雑化＝ＢＩＳ総支配人
item.description:
Marc Jones
[ロンドン ５日 ロイター] - 国際決済銀行（ＢＩＳ）のエルナンデス・デコス総支配人は５日、中...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中銀の今後の危機対応、債務増や市場変化で複雑化＝ＢＩＳ総支配人 0:41 配信

国際決済銀行（ＢＩＳ）のエルナンデス・デコス総支配人。２０２４年２月撮影。REUTERS/Yiannis Kourtoglou

Marc Jones

[ロンドン ５日 ロイター] - 国際決済銀行（ＢＩＳ）のエルナンデス・デコス総支配人は５日、中央銀行は今後も金融危機対応において中心的な役割を果たすものの、公的債務の増大やその他の重要な変化により、その任務はより困難で物議を醸すものになる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

デコス氏はウィーンでの講演で、過去２０年間に相次いだ危機は、中銀の迅速な対応が市場の混乱を鎮める上でいかに重要であるかを示したと指摘。同時に、次の危機を取り巻く環境は急速に変化しているとの見方も示した。

多くの国・地域で公的債務の水準は第２次世界大戦後の最高水準に近づいており、財政赤字も依然として大きく、財政面の圧力は今後も続くと予想されている。このため、介入を必要とする市場の機能不全と、政府財政を巡る投資家の正当な懸念を中銀が区別することが難しくなる可能性がある。

足元では世界的に債券利回りが急上昇し、独仏１０年債利回り格差は先週、１２５．９０ｂｐと２０１２年６月以来の高水準となった。

こうした中、デコス氏は「市場の機能不全が金融の安定や金融政策の波及を脅かす場合、中銀は介入する必要がある」と言明。その上で「ただ、債務水準が高く、公的な資金調達ニーズが大きい時には、綿密に設計された措置であっても、財政的な観点から解釈される恐れがある」と語った。

さらにデコス氏は、ヘッジファンドや年金基金、資産運用会社といった「ノンバンク金融機関」の影響力が高まっている点にも言及。これら金融機関は国債の主要な保有者となっており、平時には市場の流動性を支える一方、レバレッジの活用や市場ベースの資金調達により、混乱時にはストレスを増幅させる可能性があるとし、２０２０年３月の米国債市場での「現金への殺到」や、２２年の英国債市場の危機をその証拠として挙げた。

デコス氏は、来年に任期満了となるラガルド欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）総裁の後任の有力候補の一人と目されている。
